title: 赵将军歌
author: 岑参

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 赵将军歌 — 岑参
九月天山风似刀，城南猎马缩寒毛。
将军纵博场场胜，赌得单于貂鼠袍。
